fields.statement: QA at cbb3a6a44 with built rhiza and tools/release binaries in a scratch repo: real `rhiza note add <cs>` notes 'breaking: drops --old', '  SEVERE:  loses data ', 'breaking changes ahead' and 'severe: crash on start' on a second change set gave `tools/release marks` = breaking [drops --old], severe [loses data] and severe [crash on start]; the plain-text note was ignored; editing an unlanded note with `rhiza set` updated its mark. Gaps: a note retracted with `rhiza retire` before landing (written as body.drop, not node.retire) still counted as a mark, and 'severe:' with an empty reason counted with reason ''. `tools/release marks` on this repo prints {}; go test ./tools/release passes; workflow check plan-bug and bugfix pass.
